course.name: No Nonsense Forex
course.tagline: A free forex education platform run by "VP", with an advanced paid course and a dedicated trading psychology course.
course.about: No Nonsense Forex is a forex trading education platform built mostly around free content from its founder, known publicly as "VP". It covers money management, trading psychology, technical analysis and trade entries through blog posts, a YouTube channel, and a podcast, with a Discord community for trader support. A licensed advanced course (Stonehill Forex 201) and a separate trading psychology course are sold as paid add-ons.

course.testimonials_note: We didn't find individually-quoted testimonials we could independently verify, so none are shown here.

_notes.source: One of the most well-known free forex education brands (large YouTube/podcast following), added for directory credibility rather than affiliate revenue — no affiliate relationship exists. The founder goes publicly only by "VP" and doesn't disclose a full name on the official site, so we've used that rather than guess a surname from secondhand sources. Paid course details and price ($349 for Stonehill Forex 201) confirmed via WebSearch of the officially-licensed course site (stonehillforex.com); the Trading Psychology Course's price wasn't found published anywhere, so it's described but not priced. No Trustpilot profile found. No usable logo found (favicon resolved to a generic placeholder, not a real brand mark), so a lettermark shows instead.
